name: Hearing Room

steps.text: Go in by the pillar marked 333, through the double doors with the university’s logo.
The Hearing Room is on the 4th floor. After exiting the elevator, turn left.
It is the room just before the Caucus Room, marked orange on the map.

source: Named by the October 7 housing workshop on the live site (SAC Hearing Rm., 4th floor) and in Connect's event list; the live site has no directions for it. Steps are the Caucus Room’s (owner, 20 Oct 2026: “Hearing Room and Multipurpose room can use the Caucus room steps, edit the image of the map to show where the rooms are”); the plan’s own label places the room.
